A Russian Poem

一首俄罗斯诗 · 192 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1As a child, Anton often recited poems at weddings, accompanied by pianists and violinists, before the bride and bridegroom exchanged rings. Gradually, he found writing poems the most appropriate way to convey his joy and sorrow. When his poem Contradictory Blank won a national competition and earned him a sponsor’s scholarship to study at Moscow University, he was just an unknown librarian. After getting his diploma, he devoted his life to writing poems. His style was to use concrete but flexible language and a minimum of words. He tried out different patterns and liked nursery rhymes in particular. Here is a translation of one of his poems, which has three stanzas:

2Little sparrow, carrying a heavy load, you are out of strength and bitterly cold. With no compass and sweat that tastes of salt, can you make it through the endless darkness? Little balloon, freed from its thread, flew over cottages, glad to be free. With warmth from the sun, he said he could fly forever. Take it easy, little balloon. Don’t tease the wounded sparrow. Let him rest on the bare branch. This diamond heart will find success in the end.

一首俄罗斯诗

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1从童年起，安东就常在婚礼上朗诵诗歌。新郎新娘交换戒指前，钢琴家和小提琴家为他伴奏。渐渐地，他发现写诗最能表达自己的喜怒哀乐。他的诗《矛盾的留白》为他赢得全国比赛冠军，也让他拿到一位赞助人提供的奖学金，可以去莫斯科大学读书。那时，他还只是个默默无闻的图书管理员。拿到文凭以后，他把一生献给了诗歌创作。他善于用具体而灵活的语言，把意思写得尽量简短。他尝试过许多形式，尤其喜欢童谣。下面是他一首诗的译文，全诗分三节。

2小麻雀背着重重的行囊，力气耗尽，身子冰凉。没有指南针，汗水咸咸，你能穿过无边的黑夜吗？小气球挣开绳线，欢喜地飞过一座座小屋。阳光给了他暖意，他说自己能永远飞翔。放轻松吧，小气球，别嘲笑受了伤的小麻雀。让他在光秃秃的枝头歇一歇吧。这颗钻石般坚强的心，终有一天会成功。
